extension.description: A netrunner look in calm cyan with pink accents: cut corners, glitch titles and big artwork, with online movie and TV data from TMDb Helper.
extension.news: 0.4.58 - Down from above skips a row of tabs and lands on its content, Up reaches the tabs: genre rows, cast and crew, search results. Cast and crew tabs switch as soon as the cursor is on them, no OK needed. Episode info pages show resolution, HDR or SDR and the audio track. The skin settings pick the colour scheme. New add-on icon.[CR]0.4.57 - The skin settings open on the main menu, which now comes first and holds the glow switch under Effects. The Effects category and the separate Home pages entry in the settings are gone, Skin leads to the same page.[CR]0.4.56 - Up and Down on the number pad (PIN and number entry) keep the column, like on the keyboard.[CR]0.4.55 - The - and + of a setting with a value range drop their boxes and the pink: the selected sign sits on a small dark chip. The slider knob turns light instead of pink while it moves.[CR]0.4.54 - Down from Play on an episode lands on the episodes, past the season tabs; up from the episodes reaches them.[CR]0.4.53 - The quick menu links (Settings, System, Files) also work over an info page or a TMDb Helper chain: they close it first. The chapter cards show the start time once, under the picture.[CR]0.4.52 - The spotlight fades in on every switch between home and movies, also when both show the same movie. The chapter row shows Kodi's own chapter pictures in full cards when the Jellyfin server has none, instead of short cards without a picture.[CR]0.4.51 - The episode number stands before the title under the picture, where bright pictures no longer hide it. The top menu wraps around: left on home reaches the quick menu icon, right on it home again. A held Home key opens the quick menu also on remotes whose Home key Kodi knows as browser_home or home. The quick menu links the file manager (Files).[CR]0.4.50 - Up and Down on the keyboard keep the column: Down from e lands on d, not on the key that had the focus last in that row.[CR]0.4.49 - First public release. A calm cyberpunk skin for Kodi 21 with configurable home, movies and shows pages, info pages that walk top down, endless cast and crew navigation through TMDb Helper, a search page, a quick menu with clock, weather and power, and a player with track panels, chapter row and cast row.
